Plot Model Seropositivity: Baseline vs Fitted vs Data

plot_baseline_and_fitted_sero.Rd

Simulates the model using provided parameters and compares baseline and fitted outputs for seropositivity against observed data. Returns a faceted ggplot by age group.

Usage

plot_baseline_and_fitted_sero(
  param_list,
  compare_data = serodata,
  n_particles = n_particles,
  n_groups = 2
)

Arguments

param_list

A named list of model parameters, as produced by custom_data_process_wrapper.

compare_data

A data.frame of serological observations with columns: time (numeric) and serosurvey (list-column of numeric vectors by age). Default is serodata.

n_particles

Number of particles to use in the dust system (default uses `n_particles` from calling environment).

n_groups

Number of particle groups for simulation (default 2: baseline and fitted).

Value

A ggplot2 object showing seropositivity over time by age group, with model baseline, fitted, and observed data overlaid.
